title.narrative: NLB Bank Slovenia (f. P Reka, Bail-in-able Programme)

description.narrative: On 12 July 2022, the EBRD invested EUR 46 million in 3NC2 senior preferred bonds issued by Nova Ljubljanska banka d.d. ("NLB"), a commercial bank incorporated in Slovenia, as a part of its EUR 300 million public bond issuance. On 21 November 2022, EBRD invested further EUR 40 million in 10NC5 Tier2-eligible subordinated bonds, as a part of NLB's EUR 225 million public issuance that was listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On 27 June 2023, the EBRD invested EUR 35 million in 4NC3 senior preferred green bond ('SP GB'), as a part of NLB's EUR 500 million debut benchmark public issuance. The bonds are listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On the 24 January 2024, the EBRD invested EUR 15 million in 10NC5 Tier2-eligible subordinated bonds, as a part of NLB's EUR 300 million public issuance that was listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On 29 May 2024, the EBRD invested EUR 20 million in 6NC5 senior preferred bonds as a part of NLB's EUR 500 million public issuance. The bonds are listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. On 21 January 2025, the EBRD invested EUR 17.5 million in 4NC3 senior preferred bonds as a part of NLB's EUR 500 million public issuance. The bonds are listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. The project supports the resilience and regulatory compliance of the largest bank in Slovenia, helps deepening the capital markets and delivers on the Bank's green agenda and national green economy priorities for Slovenia.
